verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations such as triggers, SLOs, and alert routing is a fair question for an observability SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that the Honeycomb API can programmatically manage triggers and SLOs, with a downloadable OpenAPI spec. That is a developer building block a user could combine with external version control, not a product-provided version history, review flow, or rollback. Nothing in the pack documents any of the three.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
